_doc: FABLE-068: the class starting zones' encounters. Generated by tools/gen_start_zones.py.

encounters.name: Dockside Duelist Wren
dialogue_intro: Saltmere's lower market floods twice a day. Between tides, the aspirants duel on the stalls.
A young duelist flicks seawater from her wand. "First lesson's free. Try to keep up."
dialogue_outro: Wren laughs, soaked to the knee. "Not bad. The market will want a look at you."

encounters.name: The Breakwater Golem
dialogue_intro: Something of barnacled stone wades out of the shallows, set to guard the toll-steps.
Its rune-eyes flare. Spell-wrought, it lets no one pass unpaid.
dialogue_outro: The golem slumps back into the surf, its runes guttering out. The toll-steps are yours.
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: Spell-Broker Maddoc
dialogue_intro: In a stall stacked with stoppered bottles, a broker sells spells by the breath.
"You've been casting magic you never paid for, friend. Let's settle the account."
dialogue_outro: Maddoc counts what is left of his stock and sighs. "Call it even. Don't come back."
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: Brine-Hexer Ilsa
dialogue_intro: A woman in a coat of fishskin draws a ward of seawater around herself.
"Strike all you like. The tide gives back what it takes."
dialogue_outro: Her ward bursts like a wave on rock. "Well," Ilsa says, dripping. "The tide was wrong."
lesson: WARD
WARD blocks the next damage, once. Pop it with a small hit or a cheap spell before you send in something big.

encounters.name: Tidecaller Pell
dialogue_intro: On a drowned bell-tower, a tidecaller chants the sea higher with every verse.
"Saltmere is mine at high water. And the water is always rising."
dialogue_outro: The chant breaks. The sea, sulking, slides back down the tower steps.
lesson: RITUALS
A card with no Strength and no Vigor is a Ritual: it resolves the moment it is played. This foe leans on them — spread your board so one spell can't undo it.

encounters.name: The Undertow Captain
dialogue_intro: A drowned galleon lists in the harbour mouth. Her captain never left her.
"Saltmere owes me a ship. You'll do as a down payment."
dialogue_outro: The captain sinks back into the dark water, saluting as he goes.
lesson: PIERCE
PIERCE: damage past a killed blocker carries on to the player. Chump-blocking with a tiny creature will not fully save you.

encounters.name: Archivist Corran
dialogue_intro: Under the market lies a sunken library, its shelves read only at low tide.
"Every spell you cast, I have already catalogued. Show me something new."
dialogue_outro: Corran scribbles furiously. "A new entry. How thrilling. How humiliating."
lesson: READ THE TABLE
Along the top you can see how many cards your foe is holding. A full hand late in a fight usually means something big is coming — keep a blocker back.

encounters.name: Warden Seraphine of the Tide-Gate
dialogue_intro: At the Tide-Gate, the whole sea is held back by one woman's will.
"Aspirants come every season. Few pass. Show me you can hold a spell under pressure."
dialogue_outro: Seraphine steps back from the gate. "Then come below. See what I have been holding back."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Seraphine, the Drowned Archmage
dialogue_intro: The gate opens. Seraphine stands in the eye of a standing wave.
"Saltmere was a city once, not a market. I drowned it to seal what sleeps beneath — and I would do it again."
dialogue_outro: The wave collapses. Seraphine kneels in the shallows. "Go, then. The deep road is open. Beyond it, the Cinderfall Steps."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.

encounters.name: Gravedigger Hobb
dialogue_intro: Palewatch buries its dead in tiers — a city of bone stacked to the clouds.
An old gravedigger leans on his spade. "Fresh blood for the Veils? Let's see if you can raise more than dust."
dialogue_outro: Hobb nods slowly. "You'll do. The dead are watching you now."

encounters.name: The Ossuary Sentinel
dialogue_intro: A sentinel of stacked skulls blocks the stair to the lower crypts.
It was built to stand, not to think — and it stands very well.
dialogue_outro: The sentinel topples, skulls rolling down the stair like dice.
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: Purger Halvard
dialogue_intro: A knight of the dawn church has come to cleanse the Veils with lantern and blade.
"Every corpse you raise is a soul you steal. I will put them back to rest — and you with them."
dialogue_outro: Halvard's lantern goes out. "The abbess will hear of this," he gasps, and flees up the stair.
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: The Twice-Buried
dialogue_intro: The ground heaves. Something that was buried has decided not to stay that way.
Bury it once and it climbs back. You will have to bury it again.
dialogue_outro: This time it stays down. Mostly.
lesson: UNEARTH
Some creatures claw their way back out of the Barrow — that is UNEARTH. Killing one may not be the end of it.

encounters.name: Rotbloom Widow
dialogue_intro: In the grave-gardens, nightshade grows from the graves of poisoners.
The widow tending them smiles. "Every bloom here killed someone. Care to smell one?"
dialogue_outro: The widow wilts among her flowers. Even the nightshade turns away from you.
lesson: VENOM
VENOM: anything it damages in combat is destroyed. Don't trade your best creature into it — block with something small, or kill it with a ritual.

encounters.name: Lantern-Abbess Mirel
dialogue_intro: The Purger's abbess comes herself, a procession of lanterns behind her.
"Palewatch was a holy place before your kind came. It will be again."
dialogue_outro: The lanterns gutter one by one. Mirel lowers her staff. "Not today, then. But the dawn always comes."
lesson: SWIFT
SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they arrive. Keep a blocker up — and use your own to finish a foe that thinks it is safe.

encounters.name: Bone-Scribe Ettrin
dialogue_intro: A rival necromancer records every death in Palewatch in a ledger bound in skin.
"Your name is not in my book yet. Let's correct that."
dialogue_outro: Ettrin tears a page out of his ledger — the one with your name half-written.
lesson: READ THE TABLE
Along the top you can see how many cards your foe is holding. A full hand late in a fight usually means something big is coming — keep a blocker back.

encounters.name: Warden Corvane, Keeper of the Veils
dialogue_intro: At the top of the bone city, the Keeper decides who may command the dead.
"Many can wake a corpse. Few can make it obey. Show me."
dialogue_outro: Corvane's thralls kneel — to you. "Interesting," he says. "Come down to the throne."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Corvane, the Pale Sovereign
dialogue_intro: The Keeper sheds his robe. Beneath is bone, and an old light burning in empty sockets.
"I have ruled the Veils for three hundred years. I did not do it by losing."
dialogue_outro: The light in Corvane's eyes dims. "The Veils are yours. Beyond them, the Cinderfall Steps — go and be feared there."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.

encounters.name: Squire-Captain Bram
dialogue_intro: In the training yards of Sunspire, every oath begins with a bruise.
"On guard, recruit. The light helps those who keep their shield up."
dialogue_outro: Bram lowers his practice blade. "Good. Now go and swear it for real."

encounters.name: Shieldwall Veteran Hesk
dialogue_intro: An old soldier holds the bridge out of Sunspire, as he has for twenty years.
"Nobody crosses my bridge without showing me their shield-work."
dialogue_outro: Hesk steps aside, rubbing his shield arm. "That'll do. Mind the marches."
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: Oathbreaker Sir Vael
dialogue_intro: A knight in tarnished gold has turned his sword on the order that raised him.
"Oaths are chains, child. I broke mine. Let me show you how."
dialogue_outro: Vael's blade cracks across the sigil of the Spire. He does not get up.
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: Sister Lumen of the Lantern
dialogue_intro: A cleric of a rival order bars the pilgrim road, wrapped in wards of light.
"Sunspire's light is not yours alone. Prove you deserve it."
dialogue_outro: Her wards fade like morning mist. "Go in light, then," she says, and means it.
lesson: WARD
WARD blocks the next damage, once. Pop it with a small hit or a cheap spell before you send in something big.

encounters.name: The Gilded Bulwark
dialogue_intro: A war-construct of the old order, armoured in plates of beaten gold.
It was made to outlast sieges. It has outlasted its makers.
dialogue_outro: The Bulwark grinds to a halt, one golden fist still raised in salute.
lesson: ARMOR
ARMOR takes that much less damage from every hit. Many small hits do little — hit it once, and hit it hard.

encounters.name: Hollow Raider Kesh
dialogue_intro: Raiders from the Hollows have struck the outer chapels and looted the reliquaries.
"Gold and bones sell the same in the Hollows. Yours will too."
dialogue_outro: Kesh drops the stolen relics and runs. The chapel bells ring out behind you.
lesson: SWIFT
SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they arrive. Keep a blocker up — and use your own to finish a foe that thinks it is safe.

encounters.name: Inquisitor Aldric
dialogue_intro: An inquisitor of the Spire questions every knight who seeks the high marches.
"Faith untested is only habit. Let us test yours."
dialogue_outro: Aldric bows his head. "Tested, and true. Go on."
lesson: READ THE TABLE
Along the top you can see how many cards your foe is holding. A full hand late in a fight usually means something big is coming — keep a blocker back.

encounters.name: Warden Dawnhild
dialogue_intro: At the Sunspire's gate, the High Warden keeps the first flame.
"Every knight of Sunspire stood where you stand. Not all of them walked away."
dialogue_outro: Dawnhild lowers her shield. "Then face me at the flame itself."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Dawnhild, the Unbroken Wall
dialogue_intro: The first flame rises around her like wings.
"I have never yielded a step. Not to the dark, and not to you."
dialogue_outro: For the first time in her life, Dawnhild yields a step. "The marches are yours, knight. The Cinderfall Steps wait beyond."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.

encounters.name: Grove-Keeper Tamsin
dialogue_intro: In the canopies of Mossgrave, new druids are tested by the forest itself.
"The roots told me you were coming. Show me you can listen back."
dialogue_outro: Tamsin smiles. "The forest likes you. Don't make it change its mind."

encounters.name: The Bark-Hide Bear
dialogue_intro: A bear with bark for a hide stands across the path, guarding its den.
It does not want to fight. It will, though.
dialogue_outro: The bear lumbers back into its den, grumbling. The path is clear.
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: Poacher-Lord Garran
dialogue_intro: Snares and cages hang from every branch. Someone is stealing the forest's beasts.
"Druids fetch a fine price too, you know."
dialogue_outro: You spring the cages. The beasts of Mossgrave scatter into the green, and Garran with them.
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: The Thicket Pack
dialogue_intro: Eyes in the underbrush. Then many eyes.
The pack moves before you can count them.
dialogue_outro: The pack melts back into the thicket. Somewhere, a wolf howls — almost respectfully.
lesson: SWIFT
SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they arrive. Keep a blocker up — and use your own to finish a foe that thinks it is safe.

encounters.name: Blightcaller Venn
dialogue_intro: Where he walks, the moss turns grey and the trees weep black sap.
"The old growth is dying anyway. I'm only helping it along."
dialogue_outro: Venn falls, and green creeps back over the grey where he stood.
lesson: VENOM
VENOM: anything it damages in combat is destroyed. Don't trade your best creature into it — block with something small, or kill it with a ritual.

encounters.name: The Rot-Hart
dialogue_intro: A great stag, its antlers hung with grave-moss, stalks the blighted glade.
The blight has taken it. Put it to rest.
dialogue_outro: The Rot-Hart lies down among the ferns. Flowers open where it fell.
lesson: PIERCE
PIERCE: damage past a killed blocker carries on to the player. Chump-blocking with a tiny creature will not fully save you.

encounters.name: Hedge-Witch Morrow
dialogue_intro: A witch in a hut of living thorn trades in favours from the wild.
"You want through my hedge? Pay in sweat."
dialogue_outro: Morrow's hedge parts with a sigh. "Paid in full. Off you go."
lesson: READ THE TABLE
Along the top you can see how many cards your foe is holding. A full hand late in a fight usually means something big is coming — keep a blocker back.

encounters.name: Warden Oakheart
dialogue_intro: The oldest tree in Mossgrave opens its eyes.
"I have watched druids grow for a thousand years. Grow, little sapling. Show me."
dialogue_outro: Oakheart creaks with something like laughter. "Then come to my roots."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Oakheart, the Deep Root
dialogue_intro: The ground splits. The Warden's roots run under the whole of the wilds.
"All of Mossgrave is my body. You cannot cut it all down."
dialogue_outro: Oakheart settles, a forest at peace. "The wilds will remember you. The Cinderfall Steps will not be so kind."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.

encounters.name: Fence-Mother Agathe
dialogue_intro: Under Duskchapel's candlelit crypts, the thieves' guild takes on new blood.
"So you want to be one of us. Lift my purse, darling — if you can."
dialogue_outro: Agathe checks her belt and finds it lighter. "Ha! Welcome to the family."

encounters.name: Crypt-Guard Bolsover
dialogue_intro: A hulking guard minds the chapel door, paid by the night and paid well.
"Nobody gets past old Bolsover. Nobody."
dialogue_outro: Bolsover wakes up an hour later with his keys missing and no idea why.
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: The Candle-Snuffer
dialogue_intro: Every light in the nave goes out at once. Someone is very good at this.
"You're in my dark now."
dialogue_outro: You light a candle. The Snuffer is gone — but so is the dark.
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: Quickfinger Lisle
dialogue_intro: A pickpocket half your age darts out of the crowd at the vigil market.
"Race you to the bottom of your pockets!"
dialogue_outro: Lisle hands back your coin purse with a wink. "Fair's fair. You're faster."
lesson: SWIFT
SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they arrive. Keep a blocker up — and use your own to finish a foe that thinks it is safe.

encounters.name: Nightshade Priest Ozias
dialogue_intro: The chapel's own priest brews poison in the communion cup.
"A sip for the faithful. A gulp for thieves."
dialogue_outro: Ozias chokes on his own sermon. You leave the cup well alone.
lesson: VENOM
VENOM: anything it damages in combat is destroyed. Don't trade your best creature into it — block with something small, or kill it with a ritual.

encounters.name: Sexton Graul's Diggers
dialogue_intro: A gang of grave-robbers has claimed the lower crypts, and they don't share.
"These dead are spoken for, rat."
dialogue_outro: The diggers scatter into the tunnels, leaving their loot — and their shovels.
lesson: PIERCE
PIERCE: damage past a killed blocker carries on to the player. Chump-blocking with a tiny creature will not fully save you.

encounters.name: Veilwalker Sable
dialogue_intro: A thief who is there, then not, then behind you.
"You'll never land a hit on what you can't see."
dialogue_outro: Sable is suddenly very easy to see, sitting on the floor. "...Lucky."
lesson: DODGE
DODGE gives a chance to take no combat damage at all. Rituals are the surer answer.

encounters.name: Warden Mortimer, Master of Keys
dialogue_intro: The guild's Master of Keys guards the vault beneath the altar.
"Every lock in Duskchapel answers to me. Let's see if you do."
dialogue_outro: Mortimer tosses you a key. "The vault, then. He's waiting."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Mortimer, Guildmaster of Knives
dialogue_intro: The vault door swings open on a man with a knife for every finger.
"I taught half this city to steal. I'll teach you to lose."
dialogue_outro: Mortimer bows from the floor. "The guild is yours, Guildmaster. Rob the Cinderfall Steps for me."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.

encounters.name: Star-Reader Ulla
dialogue_intro: In the observatory-spires of Starfall Reach, the first lesson is always the sky.
"The stars said you'd come tonight. Let's see if they also said you'd win."
dialogue_outro: Ulla marks a new point on her star chart. "You're on the map now."

encounters.name: The Orrery Sentinel
dialogue_intro: A great brass orrery has woken and set itself to guard the stair.
Its planets wheel faster as you approach.
dialogue_outro: The planets slow, then stop. The sentinel ticks once, and is still.
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: Eclipse Cultist Morwen
dialogue_intro: Robed figures chant on the dark side of the peak, calling for the sun to go out.
"When the eclipse comes, every star you lean on goes dark."
dialogue_outro: The chanting stops. Overhead, the stars come back one by one.
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: The Comet-Touched Hermit
dialogue_intro: An old hermit lives in the crater where a star fell. The light never quite left him.
"It spoke to me as it fell. It said you'd be trouble."
dialogue_outro: The hermit chuckles. "It was right, you know. It's always right."
lesson: WARD
WARD blocks the next damage, once. Pop it with a small hit or a cheap spell before you send in something big.

encounters.name: Lunar Acolyte Sera
dialogue_intro: An acolyte of the moon practises her rites on the highest terrace.
"The moon pulls the tide. Let's see what it pulls out of you."
dialogue_outro: Sera's rite falls apart in silver dust. "Next full moon," she promises.
lesson: RITUALS
A card with no Strength and no Vigor is a Ritual: it resolves the moment it is played. This foe leans on them — spread your board so one spell can't undo it.

encounters.name: The Starborn Colossus
dialogue_intro: Something made of night and constellations climbs over the ridge.
It fell from the sky long ago. It wants to go home.
dialogue_outro: The colossus breaks apart into stars, and they rise — home at last.
lesson: SWIFT
SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they arrive. Keep a blocker up — and use your own to finish a foe that thinks it is safe.

encounters.name: Void-Gazer Teodric
dialogue_intro: A scholar has stared into the dark between the stars for far too long.
"There is nothing there, you know. Nothing at all. It's beautiful."
dialogue_outro: Teodric blinks, as if waking. "Oh. You're still here. How... bright."
lesson: READ THE TABLE
Along the top you can see how many cards your foe is holding. A full hand late in a fight usually means something big is coming — keep a blocker back.

encounters.name: Warden Celestine of the High Spire
dialogue_intro: At the top of the highest spire, the Warden turns the great lens.
"I chart every fate in the Reach. Yours ends here — or begins."
dialogue_outro: Celestine looks up from the lens. "Begins, then. Come up to the dome."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Celestine, Who Turns the Heavens
dialogue_intro: The dome opens. The stars wheel overhead at her command.
"The heavens obey me. Shall I bring them down on you?"
dialogue_outro: The sky settles back into its old shape. "The Heights are yours. Read the Cinderfall Steps in the stars — they burn."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.

encounters.name: Pit-Master Dunn
dialogue_intro: Every warrior of Emberhold starts in the pit, under the forge-light.
"Fists up, fresh meat. Hit me like you mean it."
dialogue_outro: Dunn spits and grins. "You'll bleed fine. Off to the passes with you."

encounters.name: Shieldbearer Orla
dialogue_intro: A shieldbearer holds the narrow pass, her tower shield planted in the rock.
"You want through? Go through me."
dialogue_outro: Orla hefts her dented shield onto her back. "Through me it is. Well fought."
lesson: GUARD
Attacks on an empty lane hit a GUARD creature first. Put one where you are open — and when the enemy has one, break it before you go for their Vigor.

encounters.name: Forge-Golem Mk. IV
dialogue_intro: A smoking iron golem stomps out of an abandoned forge, its furnace roaring.
It was built for war. Nobody ever told it the war ended.
dialogue_outro: The furnace in its chest goes cold. The golem finally rests.
lesson: ELITE
Elites start with more Vigor and pay out more: shards, a dig charge and stratum fragments. Build a board before you start trading.

encounters.name: The Cinder Raiders
dialogue_intro: Raiders on fire-hardened horses come screaming down the slope.
"Grab what burns, leave the rest!"
dialogue_outro: The raiders wheel away up the mountain, lighter by a few horses.
lesson: SWIFT
SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they arrive. Keep a blocker up — and use your own to finish a foe that thinks it is safe.

encounters.name: Spearwife Halla
dialogue_intro: A veteran with a spear as long as two men waits at the ford.
"Shields won't save you from this."
dialogue_outro: Halla plants her spear in the riverbed. "Huh. Maybe they would."
lesson: PIERCE
PIERCE: damage past a killed blocker carries on to the player. Chump-blocking with a tiny creature will not fully save you.

encounters.name: The Ashen Berserker
dialogue_intro: A berserker covered in ash and old scars roars from the top of the ridge.
There is nothing left in him but the fight.
dialogue_outro: The berserker falls silent at last. Ash drifts down like snow.
lesson: ARMOR
ARMOR takes that much less damage from every hit. Many small hits do little — hit it once, and hit it hard.

encounters.name: Lone Champion Brannoc
dialogue_intro: A single champion stands on the bridge, alone by choice.
"I fight best with no one beside me."
dialogue_outro: Brannoc sits down on the bridge. "Maybe I'll try a friend next time."
lesson: EXALTED
Their first attacker each turn gets +1/+1 for each Exalted creature they control. Kill the Exalted ones and the big swing shrinks.

encounters.name: Warden Ironhand
dialogue_intro: At the gates of Emberhold, the Warden of the Forge keeps the last trial.
"Every blade in this city was tested on my anvil. Now you."
dialogue_outro: Ironhand nods once. "Tempered. Now come and face the forge itself."
lesson: WARDEN
The keeper of this land. Wardens carry Relics too — each gathers charges and fires when full. Hold a card or Relic to read it.

encounters.name: Ironhand, the Forge-Tyrant
dialogue_intro: The great forge bursts into flame behind him. The mountain shakes.
"Emberhold was built on blood and iron. Add yours."
dialogue_outro: The forge-fire dies to embers. "Emberhold salutes you," Ironhand rasps. "Take the Cinderfall Steps — they're hotter still."
lesson: BOSS RULES
Bosses bend the rules. Your leftmost lane starts buried and only opens when the boss's first creature dies — kill one early.
